Replacing $a$ and $b$ with $c = a + b + ab$ gives

$$1 + c = 1 + a + b + ab = (1+a)(1+b).$$

So the product $P = \prod (1+x)$ over all numbers on the board is invariant under each operation.

Initially,

$$P = \prod_{k=1}^{100}\left(1+\frac{1}{k}\right) = \prod_{k=1}^{100}\frac{k+1}{k} = \frac{101}{1} = 101.$$

When one number $x$ remains, $1 + x = 101$, so $x = 100$.
